title: Blueberry Mint Sparkling Refresher
excerpt: A bubbly, natural, lightly sweet drink, perfect for hot days or for entertaining guests.
imageAlt: Glasses of blueberry sparkling refresher with fresh blueberries and sprigs of mint

ingredients.text: 10 mint leaves, plus a few more for garnish

steps: In a pitcher, muddle the blueberries with the mint and honey until they release their juice. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Add the lemon juice and stir.
Fill the pitcher with ice and top with the sparkling water.
Stir gently and serve with whole blueberries and mint leaves.
tips: For a still version, use cold water and let the pitcher rest for 30 minutes in the fridge so the flavor intensifies.
Freeze blueberries inside ice cubes: they decorate and chill without watering down the drink.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
